title: Anthropic’s quarterly revenue passed $11.5bn, up more than 14-fold
summary: Anthropic has told prospective investors that second-quarter revenue exceeded $11.5bn, more than 14 times the $787mn it made a year earlier, and that it recorded positive adjusted operating income. Anthropic has told prospective investors that its second-quarter revenue passed $11.5bn.
